author: Quaternius
licence: CC0 1.0 (License.txt in this directory, fetched from the pack's Drive folder; also stated on quaternius.com/packs/easyenemy.html)
gate: EVALUATE per docs/CONTENT_PACKS.json enemyVariety: download-and-render before any build work; 'only worth the Blender work if the contact sheet clears 3+'.
method: All 6 FBX rendered via headless Blender 5.1.2 (EEVEE, factory settings, <name>__part rename before handle Empties). Contact sheet reviewed model by model against the menace bar that culled Ultimate Monsters ('silhouette reads as a threat rather than a mascot').
verdict: SKIP ALL. 1 of 6 clears the menace bar; the gate needs 3+.
opacityTrap: CONFIRMED pack-wide: every one of the 6 FBX imports materials with alpha 0 (Frog 4, Rat 2, Snake 7, Snake_angry 7, Spider 2, Wasp 4). Any future revisit MUST route through the blender-items.py alpha-force step or the models render as nothing.

Frog.reason: Green tree frog with a big red cartoon eye. Cute by construction, same class as the never-candidate chicken/dog set.

Rat.reason: Rounded pet-store rat with pink ears/feet/tail. A giant rat is a plausible Warren trash slot, but this silhouette reads mascot at 2-3x scale; no mangy or threatening cue anywhere.

Snake.reason: Mint-green, huge yellow eyes, pink lolling tongue. Language-app mascot, not a gate creature.

Snake_angry.reason: Same snake with eyebrows/eyelashes. Comic, not angry.

Spider.reason: Dark widow-shape with red eye cluster - the one genuine menace in the pack. One keeper cannot justify the FBX/Blender pipeline cost by itself; noted here in case a future wave assembles a vermin-themed batch worth a shared Blender pass.

Wasp.reason: Yellow-and-black cartoon bee. Bees were explicitly never-candidates in the Ultimate Monsters cull; this is the same call.

evidence: Contact sheet + per-model renders archived with the Wave 2 asset evidence (gb-wave2a/assets/easyenemy-sheet.png); FBX sources retained beside this file for any future re-evaluation at zero download cost.
